item.title: Article 142 to the Rescue: SC allows Widow to Settle Loan & Secure Release of Mortgaged Property
item.description: “Though the demand raised by the Bank is legally sustainable, we find that compliance thereof would lead to extreme hardship for the appellant.” The post Article 142 to the Rescue: SC allows Widow to Settle Loan & Secure Release of Mortgaged Property appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Bombay High Court protects TRACKON courier service trade mark from infringement
item.description: “Where a word constitutes a prominent and essential part of a registered composite/label mark, the unauthorised use of that word would amount to infringement within the meaning of Section 29(9) of the Trade Marks Act.” The post Bombay High Court protects TRACKON courier service trade mark from infringement appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Child’s Welfare over Father’s financial capacity: Chhattisgarh HC denies custody to Father Living with Second Wife without Divorce
item.description: “This Court cannot be oblivious of the future aspect that there is no certainty that the child will get better love, affection, and good atmosphere from his step-mother, in comparison to what he has been receiving from his mother since birth.” The post Child’s Welfare over Father’s financial capacity: Chhattisgarh HC denies custody to Father Living with Second Wife without Divorce appeared first on SCC Times.
